title: A Study to Learn About the Monthly Dosing Study Medicine Called Berobenatide in Adults With Breathing Problems During Sleep and Overweight or Obesity Who Do Not Use a Breathing Machine (PAP) (VESPER‑OSA 2)
official: C6491021 - A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Once-Monthly Berobenatide in Adults with Obstructive Sleep Apnea and Overweight or Obesity Not Receiving Positive Airway Pressure Therapy (Vesper-Osa 2).
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate the superiority of berobenatide QM compared to placebo for reducing apnea‑hypopnea events
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adults aged 18 years or older
2. Body mass index (BMI) ≥27 kg/m² at screening
3. Previously diagnosed with moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea
4. Unable or unwilling to use positive airway pressure (PAP) therapy, and no use of PAP therapy for at least 4 weeks prior to screening
Exclusion criteria:
1. Self-reported body weight change of more than 5% within 90 days prior to screening
2. Diagnosis of any type of diabetes (resolved gestational diabetes is permitted)
3. History of acute or chronic pancreatitis
4. Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 (MEN 2)
5. Sleep related conditions, treatments or disorders that could confound respiratory assessments of OSA including prior airway surgery, non-obstructive sleep apnea syndromes, hypoventilation disorders, non-PAP OSA treatments, significant respiratory/neuromuscular/craniofacial disease, severe insomnia, or other clinically relevant sleep disorders
